messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2.5D action-adventure combining platforming, cinematic melee combat with finishers, and an environmental puzzle.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Build the game now and briefly note assumptions when finishing.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Created a self-contained browser game, “Riftbound: The Sunken Crown,” using Canvas and inline CSS/JavaScript.
- Assumed original, stylized combat and puzzle mechanics rather than reproducing specific franchises.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a title screen, canvas-based side-scrolling game scene, responsive UI, keyboard and touch controls, melee combat, wind snare, finishers, collectibles, health, an astral-lock puzzle, and a victory state in `index.html`.
- Confirmed embedded JavaScript parses with `new Function(...)` (“JavaScript syntax OK”).
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002.

### Active
- Browser/gameplay visual and interaction verification has not been performed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open the game at `http://localhost:3002` and verify layout and gameplay, including puzzle and finish flow.
2. Fix any runtime or gameplay defects found; capture and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot.
3. Finish with a brief summary and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `start.sh`: Project start script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The HTML file is self-contained; no build tooling or external game assets were added.
